boundary.note: A curb is the physical edge of the roadway: leaving the roadway across it is not a lane change.
Nothing is marked on this side: no marking governs crossing it.

Preferential, reversible or other special lane: decide from the passages and the signs. Prefill convention (contested): changing into the special lane is prohibited (ordinary car, reserved time assumed); leaving it, when my lane is the special lane, follows the line type.

Project convention: the right edge line marks the edge of the roadway (3B.09 ¶01 to ¶02); beyond it there is no travel lane, so driving across it is not a lane change. No passage says so in words. Contested cell: scored separately.
boundary.note_zh: 项目约定：右侧边缘线表示路面边缘（3B.09 第 01 至 02 段），线外不是行车道，越过它不是变道。没有条文直接这样写。这是有争议的格子，评估时单独统计。

boundary.note: Project convention (as in the single-marking task): a single solid white lane line discourages crossing (3A.04, 3B.06 ¶06); a prohibition is shown by a double solid white line (3B.06 ¶12). Contested cell: scored separately.
boundary.note_zh: 项目约定（与单标线任务相同）：单条白实线是“不鼓励”跨越（3A.04、3B.06 第 06 段）；禁止跨越用双白实线（3B.06 第 12 段）。这是有争议的格子，评估时单独统计。

boundary.note: Broken line on my side: passing with care is permitted (also the edge of a two-way left-turn lane, 3B.05).
Reversible lane: the direction comes from signs or lane-use signals (3B.04 ¶02).

arrow:left.note: Project convention: a U-turn is made from a lane where left turns are allowed, and no passage prohibits it, so u_turn = allowed. If a NO U-TURN sign is visible, keep this answer, tick Unsure and write it in the comment. Contested cell: the arrow does not show a U-turn; scored separately. U-turn: allowed with this arrow unless a no-U-turn marking or sign is visible (owner, 2026-11-17).
